name: poetry-monorepo
description: Helps to set proper interpreter and add package path to work properly with poetry on a monorepo, where there are multiple poetry projects

poetryMonorepo.venvDiscovery.markdownDescription: Where to look for a project's interpreter, in order. `in-project` uses `.venv` next to `pyproject.toml`. `poetry` asks `poetry env info --path`. `pyenv` resolves the virtualenv named in `.python-version`. Set to `[]` to leave the interpreter alone.

enumDescriptions: Replace the existing paths with the package path
Add the package path ahead of the existing paths
poetryMonorepo.updatePythonAnalysisExtra.description: How python.analysis.extraPaths is updated when the active file moves to another Poetry project.

poetryMonorepo.pytest.enabled.markdownDescription: Set `python.testing.cwd` to the Poetry project of the active file so pytest discovers its tests.

poetryMonorepo.appendExtraPaths.description: Option to append the extra path instead of replacing. set true to retail any extraPaths you need
poetryMonorepo.appendExtraPaths.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#poetryMonorepo.updatePythonAnalysisExtraPaths#` instead. Still honoured while that setting is unset.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
